Title: Azure Security Center new analytics agent for Linux

Body.Content: Today, Azure Security Center is beginning roll out of a new Azure Linux analytics agent. This version significantly improves the onboarding of Linux VMs and servers to Security Center. When the agent rollout ends, the list of Linux versions supported by Azure Security Center will be in aligned with versions supported by the Azure Log Analytics agent.
